description: Check the processing status of an enqueued document by job id. Status is Waiting | Processing | Processed | Failed. When Processed, the response carries a result_url; pass that inference id to mindee_get_inference. V2 API: GET /v2/jobs/{job_id}.

job_id.description: Job id returned by mindee_extract_document (when it times out) or an enqueue call.

name: mindee_get_job
title: Get job status
